profile.name: E2.0 国际标准对标验收体系

standards.title: Systems and software engineering — SQuaRE — Product quality model
standards.profile_usage: Quality-model vocabulary for specifying, measuring and evaluating product quality.
notes: No clause-level conformity is claimed from the public abstract.

standards.title: Software testing — Part 1: General concepts
standards.profile_usage: Risk-based testing concepts, test basis, test oracle and test independence.
notes: Public metadata/preview only; formal conformity requires authorized full text and clause-by-clause treatment.

standards.title: Software testing — Part 2: Test processes
standards.profile_usage: Governance, management and implementation process alignment.
notes: Process alignment only; no clause-level conformity claim.

standards.title: Software testing — Part 3: Test documentation
notes: Template concepts are adapted, not copied from the protected standard.

standards.title: Software testing — Part 4: Test techniques
standards.profile_usage: Test-design-technique alignment for positive, negative and boundary cases.
notes: Technique alignment only; no clause-level conformity claim.

standards.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
standards.profile_usage: Exact open requirement IDs for E03 authorization intersection and E04/E12 Realm, data and service-layer isolation.
notes: Mapping is not an OWASP certification or an assertion that all ASVS requirements were assessed.

standards.title: Secure Software Development Framework Version 1.1
standards.status: Final; SSDF 1.2 is Draft as of retrieval date
standards.profile_usage: Security requirements/risk traceability and release component provenance evidence.

standards.status: Current version in PCI SSC Document Library

standards.title: Security and resilience — Business continuity management systems — Requirements
standards.profile_usage: Reference alignment for continuity and recovery evidence only.
notes: No BCMS conformity or certification claim is permitted.

claims.title: 同级节点共享模型与横向隔离
claims.quality_statement: 同一 line 和 parent 下的三个同级节点由同一节点模型、源码和制品服务；差异只来自权威节点、身份、Scope、Capability 和资源数据，且请求与写入不串节点。
business_risks: 同级节点分化为专属模型、业务分支或制品
Realm、Membership 或 Scope 串线
节点名称硬编码替代权威数据决策

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Frames functional suitability, reliability, security and maintainability evaluation; the shared SFL node model and zero-cross-node behavior are project-custom.
Uses positive, negative and boundary-oriented test design across three peer nodes without claiming clause-level conformity.

applicability.rationale: Horizontal peer nodes are an explicit SFL topology and isolation claim.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when Node, Relation, NodeContext, Membership, Scope, Capability or artifact topology changes.

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently reconstruct each node context, compare expected versus observed operation decisions and authoritative writes, and count source/build/artifact identities from raw inventories; do not read the test program's pass field.

inputs: H-A, H-B and H-C under one line and parent at signed level L1
distinct Realm, Membership and Scope data for each node
the same read and rollback-safe write operations for all three nodes

thresholds: all 3 nodes resolve through the same Node/Relation/Context model and parser path
source_sha/build_id/artifact_digest unique count = 1 and source_copy_count = node_specific_build_count = 0
expected versus observed context or operation-decision mismatch count = 0
unexpected authoritative-table, audit or Outbox diff count = 0
prelocked_criteria.unknown_rule: Missing any of the three node rows, operation observations, authoritative before/after diffs, or source/build/artifact inventories yields UNKNOWN.

positive_cases: The same operation set resolves and executes according to each node's declared identity and Scope
One shared source/build/artifact serves all three peer nodes
negative_cases: Cross-node Realm, Membership and Scope reuse
Any second source copy, node-specific build, model path or node-name business branch
required_raw_evidence: exact operation requests and raw decisions
claims.reviewer_role: Reviewer independent of the node-model implementation and E01 test code

current_rating.rationale: E01 is now in E2.0 scope, but its E v1 material has not yet been recalibrated against this locked criterion set.
gaps: E2.0 evidence record and independent oracle recomputation

claims.title: L0—L11 统一纵向链与关系版本完整性
claims.quality_statement: L0—L11 的 12 个节点使用同一数据模型和解析路径；父边、级号、闭包和关系版本均为可验证数据，历史关系不被覆盖，不产生 L12 业务事实。
business_risks: 层级专属模型或代码路径增生
跳级、双父、跨线借链或闭包错误
关系换版覆盖历史交易路径
级号被当作管理权或主权资源的自动授予

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Frames functional correctness, reliability and maintainability of a data-driven hierarchy; L0-L11 and the L12 boundary are project-custom.
Uses boundary, state-transition and structure-oriented test design without claiming clause-level conformity.

applicability.rationale: The L0-L11 data-driven chain is an explicit SFL topology claim.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when NodeRelation, NodeClosure, signed-level boundaries or relation versioning changes.

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently derive the expected 12-node chain and closure rows from raw parent edges, compare every active interval and relation version, and count L12 facts; ignore test summary results.

inputs: self, ancestors, descendants and subtree resolution operations

thresholds: node count = 12, current parent-edge count = 11 and L12 fact count = 0
all levels use one Node/Relation/Closure model and one resolution path
per effective interval each non-root node has exactly one same-line parent and L0 has none
relation change creates a new version while preserving the old edge and historical path
permission or sovereignty change caused solely by signed_level count = 0
prelocked_criteria.unknown_rule: Missing any level, edge interval, closure row, version diff, boundary observation or authority comparison yields UNKNOWN.

positive_cases: Resolve self, ancestors, descendants and subtree at every level
Change one relation version and reconstruct both old and current paths
negative_cases: Attempt a skip-level, second-parent or cross-line edge
Probe the L11 boundary without creating an L12 fact
Check that a higher signed level alone grants no permission or sovereign resource
required_raw_evidence: node and parent-edge rows with effective intervals
claims.executor_role: Vertical topology and relation-version test operator
claims.reviewer_role: Reviewer independent of the hierarchy implementation and E02 test code

current_rating.rationale: E02 is now in E2.0 scope, but its E v1 material has not yet been recalibrated against this locked criterion set.
gaps: E2.0 evidence record and independent chain/closure recomputation

claims.title: 功能、权限、Scope、Capability 与资源就绪五维交集
claims.quality_statement: 功能可见性与可执行性等于 feature declaration、Permission、Scope、Capability 和 resource readiness 五个布尔维度的交集；任一为 false 都在页面、API、任务和服务层失败关闭且零副作用。
business_risks: 单个权限或前端可见性绕过完整授权交集
页面、API、任务和服务层决策不一致
被拒绝请求仍产生落库、Outbox 或 Provider 副作用

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Frames functional correctness and security quality; the five-factor SFL intersection and four-surface equality are project-custom.
Maps documented authorization rules, explicit function permission, data-specific access and trusted service-layer enforcement to the E03 truth table.
Tracks security requirements, risks and design decisions for the authorization intersection.

applicability.rationale: The five-factor decision is an explicit SFL authorization and capability contract.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when Operation declarations, Permission, Scope, Capability, resource readiness or any decision surface changes.

independent_oracle.procedure: Generate the expected allow value as the conjunction of the five raw booleans for all 32 rows, compare page/API/task/service observations, and independently diff database, Outbox and provider-call facts without reading test pass flags.

inputs: all 2^5 = 32 combinations of feature_declared, permission_allowed, scope_allowed, capability_available and resource_ready
one side-effect-free read operation and one rollback-safe write operation
page, API, task and trusted service/provider probes
Hosted, Sovereign and consumer sample memberships

thresholds: truth-table row count = 32 and observation count per surface = 32
the all-true row is available on every applicable surface
each of the other 31 rows fails closed on page, API, task and service/provider surfaces
expected versus observed decision mismatch count = 0
denied-row business write, Outbox and provider-call count = 0
prelocked_criteria.unknown_rule: Any missing truth-table row, surface observation, denial reason, correlation link or direct side-effect diff yields UNKNOWN.

positive_cases: All five dimensions true for each selected operation and node type
negative_cases: Each of the five dimensions false individually while the others are true
All remaining multi-false combinations across all four decision surfaces
required_raw_evidence: page/API/task/service raw decisions with correlation IDs
claims.reviewer_role: Security reviewer independent of authorization implementation and E03 test code

current_rating.rationale: E03 is now in E2.0 scope, but its E v1 material has not yet been recalibrated against this locked criterion set.
gaps: E2.0 32-row four-surface evidence record and independent side-effect recomputation

claims.title: 同一凭据跨 Realm 的身份与会话隔离
claims.quality_statement: 同一凭据跨 Realm 仅用于发现可选身份，不合并 Account、Membership、Session、父链、Scope、权限或资产；切换 Realm 必须换发目标会话，来源权威零残留。
business_risks: 按手机号或凭据跨 Realm 合并账号与资产
单次请求同时激活多个 Membership
来源 Session、Scope 或权限在目标 Realm 残留
跨 Realm 负向请求读取数据或产生写入

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Frames security and functional correctness of identity isolation; the shared-credential Realm model is project-custom.
Maps data-specific authorization and trusted service-layer enforcement to cross-Realm identity and asset-isolation probes.
Tracks security requirements, risks and design decisions for Realm identity boundaries.

applicability.rationale: A credential may discover identities in multiple Realms while authority must remain Realm-specific.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when credential discovery, Account, Membership, Session, Realm switching, Scope or asset ownership changes.

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently compare account/membership/session/lineage/scope/asset identifiers across three Realms, enumerate all directed Realm transitions and misuse observations, and diff authoritative writes without using test summary results.

inputs: one credential reference discoverable in Realms A, B and C
source Session, Membership, Scope and node-identity misuse for read and rollback-safe write

thresholds: valid own-Realm positive case count = 3 with expected asset mismatch count = 0
for 3 Realms, all 6 directed source-to-target pairs cover 4 misuse variants x read/write = 48 negative observations
negative acceptance, cross-Realm data disclosure and authoritative write count = 0
each request has exactly 1 active Membership
all 6 Realm switches issue a target session and source Session/permission residue count = 0
cross-Realm Account, Membership, Session, lineage, Scope or asset identifier merge count = 0
prelocked_criteria.unknown_rule: Any missing positive Realm, directed pair, misuse variant, switch transition, identifier map or authoritative before/after diff yields UNKNOWN.

positive_cases: Log in separately to A, B and C and read only the active Membership's own assets
Switch each ordered source Realm to each target Realm through a newly issued target session
negative_cases: Reuse source Session, Membership, Scope or node identity for read and write against every other Realm
Attempt to retain source authority after each Realm switch
required_raw_evidence: exact positive and 48 negative request/response observations
claims.executor_role: Multi-Realm identity and session-isolation test operator
claims.reviewer_role: Security reviewer independent of identity/session implementation and E04 test code

current_rating.rationale: E04 is now in E2.0 scope, but its E v1 material has not yet been recalibrated against this locked criterion set.
gaps: E2.0 three-Realm evidence record and independent identity/session recomputation

claims.title: Hosted 生命周期零基础设施扇出
claims.quality_statement: Hosted 节点新增、停用、恢复、授权和撤销仅改变预期数据事实、审计与 Outbox；不会产生逐节点构建、发布、进程、端口、Manifest 或指针。
business_risks: 节点增长导致部署成本线性增长
Hosted 生命周期误触基础设施
停用或撤销后访问残留

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Uses the product quality model to frame reliability, maintainability and performance-related measurement; exact zero-fan-out behavior is project-custom.
Release-component provenance records support independent counting of builds and artifacts.

applicability.rationale: Hosted is an implemented SFL operating mode.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when Hosted runtime topology or lifecycle operations change.

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently diff database/audit/outbox facts and count DNS, Tunnel, systemd, Caddy, build, deploy, restart, process, port, manifest and pointer events from raw inventories and receipts; ignore the test summary result field.

thresholds: all expected data/audit/outbox diffs present and no others
prelocked_criteria.unknown_rule: Any missing raw counter, inventory, receipt or access-negative observation yields UNKNOWN.

positive_cases: Lifecycle changes create only expected facts
One shared host cutover serves all Hosted samples
negative_cases: Any Hosted-specific process/port/manifest/pointer must be detected
claims.executor_role: Environment operator with access to lifecycle and release observations
claims.reviewer_role: Reviewer independent of E05 test implementation

current_rating.rationale: E v1 evidence is preserved but was not recalibrated against E2.0 in this batch.
gaps: E2.0 evidence record and independent oracle recomputation not yet completed

claims.title: Sovereign 单节点渐进发布与回滚隔离
claims.quality_statement: 多个 Sovereign 节点可选择同源不可变制品；仅目标节点可执行 A→B→A，非目标节点的指针、进程、配置、数据和历史保持不变。
business_risks: 单节点发布波及其他节点
节点专属源码或构建分叉
回滚后不健康或历史被重算

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Frames reliability and maintainability evaluation; the A-to-B-to-A isolation sequence is project-custom.
Artifact and release provenance support source/build identity verification.
Recovery evidence is reference-aligned only; no BCMS conformity is claimed.

applicability.rationale: Sovereign nodes have independent release pointers in the SFL model.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when release-pointer or Sovereign runtime topology changes.

independent_oracle.procedure: Reconstruct artifact identity and each node pointer/process/config/data/history timeline directly from raw receipts; assert S-B A-to-B-to-A and zero non-target/history changes without reading any summary PASS/check boolean.

thresholds: S-B final health = ready on A
prelocked_criteria.unknown_rule: Any missing stage/activation/rollback/control/history raw receipt or mismatched hash yields UNKNOWN.

positive_cases: Only S-B activates B and returns to A
S-A/S-C remain healthy on A
Artifact B is eligible for all three nodes
negative_cases: Detect history recalculation or unhealthy rollback
claims.reviewer_role: Reviewer independent of E06 test design and execution

current_rating.rationale: Raw evidence supports the mechanism in three disposable Docker processes with network=none; this is not a stable real staging environment and has no independent reviewer.
gaps: Real staging identity/config/difference record
Production authorization and observation
Independent reviewer signature

claims.title: Hosted 开店与 Sovereign 升级连续性
claims.quality_statement: Hosted 原节点开店并升级为 Sovereign 时，原身份、Membership、经营线、父边、级号和历史血缘保持不变，仅新增获准的商城与主权资源事实。
business_risks: 升级产生重复节点或新血缘
Membership/级号重置
历史交易或父边被覆盖

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Frames functional suitability and reliability evaluation; identity/lineage invariants are project-custom.
Positive transition and negative mutation cases are designed as project test techniques.

applicability.rationale: Hosted mall opening and Sovereign upgrade are declared SFL transitions.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when identity, lineage or upgrade state machine changes.

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently compare immutable identity/lineage keys and history digests before and after each transition, then enumerate only allowed new mall/sovereignty/resource facts.

prelocked_criteria.unknown_rule: Any missing before/after immutable-key or history snapshot yields UNKNOWN.

positive_cases: Each original node gains permitted mall capability
Selected nodes gain Sovereign resources without identity replacement
negative_cases: Detect source copy or other-node switch

current_rating.rationale: A clean-source disposable PostgreSQL 17 replay opened the original L3/L6/L8/L11 Hosted nodes, upgraded and rolled back only L6/L8, preserved every locked identity, lineage and immutable-history digest, produced the exact versioned resource/manifest facts, changed neither non-target node, and recorded zero Hosted infrastructure or node-specific build actions. The independent raw-evidence oracle detected all four negative mutations.
gaps: Stable separately managed staging replay
Authorized real DNS/TLS/tunnel/runtime/secret/payment-provider readiness observation
Deployment and production serving observation
Independent reviewer recomputation and signature

claims.title: 多供应商四流交易完整性
claims.quality_statement: 多供应商订单的订单、商品、现金和财务事实按成交路径对齐且金额守恒；部分退款只逆转选中商品行和原供应商经济腿，关系换版不重算历史。
business_risks: 供应商/合同/结算串线
金额或库存不守恒
退款逆转其他合法经济腿
当前关系覆盖历史路径

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Frames functional suitability and reliability measurement; four-flow accounting invariants are project-custom.
Supports explicit positive, negative and boundary test design at a process-alignment level.

applicability.rationale: Multi-supplier four-flow transactions are an SFL business capability.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when order, refund, inventory or finance authority changes.

independent_oracle.procedure: Recompute line, supplier-leg, payment, refund, inventory and finance totals from authoritative rows and original route versions; compare sets and sums without reading the test result.

thresholds: refund allocation = selected original line/leg only
inventory and finance deltas reconcile exactly
prelocked_criteria.unknown_rule: Any missing authoritative flow, route version or currency-unit field yields UNKNOWN rather than inferred balance.

positive_cases: Three independent legs reconcile
Selected line partially refunds on original route
claims.reviewer_role: Finance/domain reviewer independent of test implementation

current_rating.rationale: Formal E08 execution at source SHA 7f69099221fb7468a6cb0668511086bcec6ecd95 replayed all 301 migrations in disposable PostgreSQL 17. Three supplier legs, four forward flows, two selected refunds, five simultaneous replay attempts, atomic failure probes and frozen route versions independently reconciled with zero differences; all three negative oracle mutations were detected.
gaps: No stable separately managed staging replay has been performed.
No authorized production observation has been performed.
No finance/domain reviewer independent of the E08 test implementation and execution has recomputed and signed the evidence.

claims.title: 关键写幂等、中断续跑与独立恢复
claims.quality_statement: 相同意图五路并发只形成一个权威结果；同键异请求不覆盖；固定断点中断可识别并续跑；单节点恢复不改变非目标节点。
business_risks: 重复订单/扣款/库存/退款/Outbox
冲突请求覆盖
半套事实不可恢复
恢复波及其他节点

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Frames reliability evaluation; exact idempotency and recovery invariants are project-custom.
Recovery evidence is reference-aligned only and does not assess a BCMS.

applicability.rationale: Critical SFL writes require idempotency and recoverable state transitions.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when operation catalog, transaction boundaries or provider steps change.

independent_oracle.procedure: Count authoritative business IDs, request hashes, state versions, provider receipts, audit and Outbox rows directly; compare target/non-target snapshots and reconstruct interruption continuation.

thresholds: all identical requests return one business ID
prelocked_criteria.unknown_rule: Any missing request hash, idempotency key, provider receipt or target/non-target snapshot yields UNKNOWN.

positive_cases: Five identical requests converge
Retry resumes each recorded interruption
negative_cases: Same key with different hash is rejected
claims.reviewer_role: Reviewer independent of operation and recovery implementation

current_rating.rationale: Formal E09 execution at clean source SHA 54934c682005c6c1bc1d56cf6b61d9fe7d03f2f0 replayed all 301 migrations in disposable PostgreSQL 17 and exercised the production ExecutionKernel, PgUnitOfWork and audit projection across 15 operation/node pairs. Seventy-five simultaneous deliveries converged to one authority per pair, 15 conflicting hashes changed no accepted state, all 60 fixed interruption cases recovered to one terminal business result and unique local provider receipt, and five Sovereign-C recoveries changed neither Hosted node. The independent recount found zero missing evidence or threshold violations and detected all four negative mutations.
gaps: No stable separately managed staging replay has been performed.
The DEV provider is deterministic and local; no authorized real payment, DNS or cloud-provider recovery observation has been performed.
Synthetic business actions were used behind the five registered operation IDs; this run does not establish each live module handler business contract.
No reviewer independent of the E09 workload, recovery implementation and oracle has recomputed and signed the evidence.

claims.title: 一次共享变更、一次构建与分时生效
claims.quality_statement: 一次共享内核变更只形成一个可追溯不可变制品；Hosted 随宿主一次切换，Sovereign 可分时选择版本；各身份在页面、API、任务和服务上的功能等于权威交集。
business_risks: 节点专属分支/构建
Hosted 逐节点切换
Sovereign 被迫同步升级
功能越权或合法能力缺失

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Frames functional suitability and maintainability measurement; cross-surface SFL intersection is project-custom.
Trace security requirements/risks/design decisions and preserve release component provenance.

applicability.rationale: Shared-kernel release behavior is a declared SFL architecture property.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when build graph, target graph or capability projection changes.

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently count build/artifact identities, reconstruct all node pointer timelines, and set-diff expected versus observed operations on each surface from raw responses.

inputs: Hosted host plus three Sovereign nodes

prelocked_criteria.unknown_rule: Any missing surface, identity, pointer or provenance record yields UNKNOWN.

positive_cases: Hosted host switches once
S-A/S-B switch at different times while S-C remains old
all allowed features present
claims.reviewer_role: Reviewer independent of build/release and capability-matrix implementation

current_rating.rationale: Formal E10 execution used the clean marker-only transition dfb32c2c1fefc537b74205e54bfac757a5773612→b17ebd598dbc899005100d3f289e1bc15fd5db45 and one candidate build. One Hosted host pointer switch changed H-A/H-B/H-C with zero Hosted per-node actions; S-A and S-B activated in separate ordered actions while S-C remained on A; S-B then rolled back alone. The independent oracle found zero differences across all 144 expected/observed node, identity, surface and phase cells, zero non-target rollback changes, and detected all three negative mutations.
gaps: No stable separately managed staging release replay has been performed.
No authorized production deployment or production cloud audit-log observation has been performed.
The page, API, task and service observations are isolated read-only probe transports around the production authorization kernel, not full production adapters with real traffic.
No reviewer independent of the E10 build, release fixture and oracle has recomputed and signed the evidence.

claims.title: 节点规模与代码/构建/Hosted 操作解耦
claims.quality_statement: 节点从 1 增长到 10、100、1000 时，业务源码与节点专属源码不增长，节点专属源码为零，共享变更仍只构建一个制品，Hosted 逐节点基础设施操作为零。
business_risks: 节点规模导致源码复制
构建次数随节点增长
Hosted 基础设施线性增长
规模下跨线或解析错误

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Frames performance efficiency and maintainability measurement; exact 1/10/100/1000 counts are project-custom.
Scale points and topology combinations are an explicit project test-design set.

applicability.rationale: Scale independence is an explicit SFL architecture claim.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when node materialization, build model or Hosted infrastructure changes.

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently count source files, node-specific source, build/artifact identities and Hosted infrastructure events at each locked scale; verify correctness sets separately from latency metrics.

prelocked_criteria.unknown_rule: Missing any scale/topology/count or correctness sample yields UNKNOWN; latency is reported without an unapproved pass threshold.

positive_cases: All scale/topology combinations resolve correctly
One shared artifact serves the declared population model
claims.reviewer_role: Reviewer independent of generator and counting code

current_rating.rationale: Formal E11 execution at clean source SHA 8630eabaae848ed3757bc7f252fb1fb2947af75f replayed all 301 migrations in disposable PostgreSQL 17 and ran twelve locked scale/topology scenarios covering 3,333 generated-node and 36 sovereign-control observations. The independent recount found the same 2,010 business-source files and digest at all four scales, one shared build and artifact identity, zero node-specific source/build or Hosted per-node infrastructure events, and zero resolution/isolation differences; all three negative oracle mutations were detected.
gaps: No stable separately managed staging replay has been performed.
No authorized production infrastructure audit-log observation has been performed.
No reviewer independent of the E11 generator, counting code and execution has recomputed and signed the evidence.

claims.title: 多 Realm、Scope 与节点权威隔离
claims.quality_statement: 未知/歧义 Host、跨 Realm、跨 Scope、错误节点身份、过期版本和停用身份均不解析到有效权威上下文、不产生业务写入或 Outbox；客户端伪造权威字段不能改变落库归属。
business_risks: 跨租户数据访问或写入
默认节点回退
客户端伪造落库归属
兼容路径掩盖权威缺失

standard_mappings.alignment_statement: Frames product security quality evaluation; SFL Realm/Scope/Node authority fields are project-custom.
Maps authorization-rule documentation, data-specific authorization, and trusted service-layer enforcement to E12 isolation probes.
Tracks security requirements, risks and design decisions for tenant authority boundaries.

applicability.rationale: SFL explicitly serves multiple Realm, Scope and node contexts.
applicability.review_trigger: Reassess when Host resolution, session, membership, scope, capability or write authority changes.

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently compare expected versus actual status/error/context and before/after authoritative tables for every positive, invalid and forged-field case; do not use the test program's pass flags.
